description: §5.2 rule 2, S457 bullet event-handler text from data: `ONCLICK=(@code)` — a spelling no emitter wires as a listener, with an expression value — would WRITE the data as handler text, and is refused (s462-bootstrap-sink-guards — the parenthesized twin of event-attr-data-text-neg, whose `${…}` form the bootstrap does not parse).
rationale: §5.2 rule 2 (S457): "Where an emitter would instead WRITE an `on…` attribute from data — a spelling it does not wire as a listener, such as `ONCLICK=${…}` at top level — the write SHALL be a compile error (E-ATTR-INTERP-EXECUTABLE) naming the lowercase spelling that is wired".
